evidence that the desire to seek homes in the

therefore they are more cautious than the I'm.
migrants of some other countries, who usual.
lily transfer merely their muscular strength.

creasing stream or German immigration,

corning the crops. A bad season affects the

acreage Is SO vast, and the conditions of eli
mate are so various, that general disaster toI
the crops is now next to impossible. Every

country as whole. English immigration,
now extensive, is likely, therefore, to CONTINUED
to increase while prosperity reigns IN the
United States.


The Scandinavian countries are now send
ing Us from fifty thousand to ahundred thous
and immigrants yearly. The causes which
induce them to cross the ocean are permanent.

hard, and they long for a more genial climate

migration have greatly improved of late years,
and the enthusiasm by which il has been dis
